catalogLab.description: Four approaches to section headings and item labels, using the same previews to compare hierarchy, color, and collectibility.
catalogLab.railNote: A short color rail organizes each group while the quality marker joins the item name. Restrained, stable, and ideal for long lists.
catalogLab.sealNote: Headings become subtle seals and item names feel like collection labels. More collectible, with a stronger visual presence.
catalogLab.indexNote: Numbers and fine rules form an editorial catalog that feels more mature and less card-heavy.
catalogLab.haloNote: Quality color becomes ambient light, giving Epic and Collector items a stronger moment.
catalogLab.recommendation: A soft field of quality color sits behind each heading without adding another label. Crystal icons remain fixed to the left of item names for a stable reading order.

notification.guide.bark.1.title: Install and allow notifications
notification.guide.bark.1.body: Open Bark and allow system notifications when prompted.
notification.guide.bark.2.title: Copy your private push URL
notification.guide.bark.2.body: Copy the URL beginning with https://api.day.app. Sample text at the end is safe to include; Sermo cleans it automatically.
notification.guide.bark.3.title: Send a test code
notification.guide.bark.3.body: Paste the URL, send a test, then return from Bark and enter the six-digit code.
notification.guide.ntfy.1.title: Install ntfy
notification.guide.ntfy.1.body: Use the App Store on iPhone. Android supports Google Play or the F-Droid build without FCM.
notification.guide.ntfy.2.title: Subscribe to a private topic
notification.guide.ntfy.2.body: Create a hard-to-guess topic and copy its full URL, such as https://ntfy.sh/your-topic. Add an access token only for protected topics.
notification.guide.ntfy.3.title: Confirm the test message
notification.guide.ntfy.3.body: Send a test code, confirm it arrived in ntfy, and enter the six digits here.
notification.guide.gotify.1.title: Install the client and prepare a server
notification.guide.gotify.1.body: Gotify needs a reachable server. Install the Android client and sign in to your Gotify server first.
notification.guide.gotify.2.title: Create an application token
notification.guide.gotify.2.body: In the Gotify web console, create an application dedicated to Sermo and copy its application token, not a client token.
notification.guide.gotify.3.title: Verify the server and token
notification.guide.gotify.3.body: Enter the server root URL and application token, then confirm the test code in Gotify.
notification.guide.pushdeer.1.title: Install a suitable client
notification.guide.pushdeer.1.body: Search for PushDeer in the App Store on iPhone. Android users should review the project status first; self-hosted users can use their own client and server.
notification.guide.pushdeer.2.title: Register a device and create a PushKey
notification.guide.pushdeer.2.body: Sign in, register this device under Devices, then create and copy a PushKey beginning with PDU under Keys. Add your server URL when self-hosting.
notification.guide.pushdeer.3.title: Confirm delivery with a code
notification.guide.pushdeer.3.body: Send a test using the PushKey. Once the notification arrives, enter the six-digit code to finish.
